content.value_statement: Recurring billing creates errors when subscriptions, invoices, taxes, and failed payments are handled manually. This skill guides durable billing workflows, retries, proration, and invoice generation.
actual_capabilities: Maps subscription lifecycle states, including trial, active, past due, paused, and canceled.
Outlines recurring billing cycle processing from invoice creation through payment handling.
Provides dunning retry patterns for failed payments and customer notifications.
Explains proration for plan changes, billing interval changes, and seat changes.
Covers invoice generation, tax calculation, and usage-based billing patterns.
limitations: Examples are implementation patterns and require adaptation to your billing provider.
It does not replace legal, accounting, or tax compliance review.
It does not automatically connect to payment processors or production systems.
Sandbox payment testing is required before any live customer billing.

use_cases.title: Launch SaaS Subscriptions
use_cases.description: Design plans, renewal behavior, trials, invoice generation, and payment failure handling for a new subscription product.

use_cases.title: Improve Failed Payment Recovery
use_cases.description: Create retry schedules, dunning notifications, grace periods, and cancellation rules for past due subscriptions.

use_cases.title: Add Usage-Based Charges
use_cases.description: Plan how to track usage, calculate tiered pricing, and add metered charges to recurring invoices.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Billing Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new subscription product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a simple monthly subscription billing flow with trial, renewal, invoice, payment, and cancellation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build Dunning Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a dunning workflow with retry timing, customer emails, grace period rules, and final cancellation behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Plan Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate proration design for subscription updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define proration rules for upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, and annual-to-monthly billing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Billing Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before implementation or launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my billing architecture for lifecycle gaps, invoice accuracy, tax handling, dunning behavior, and reconciliation needs.

output_examples.input: Design a subscription billing workflow for monthly and annual SaaS plans.
output_examples.output: A structured workflow covering plan setup, trial activation, renewal timing, invoice creation, payment attempts, failure handling, and cancellation rules.

output_examples.input: Create a failed payment recovery plan for overdue invoices.
output_examples.output: A dunning plan with retry intervals, message timing, customer account states, recovery actions, and final cancellation criteria.

output_examples.input: Explain how to bill for metered usage in the next invoice.
output_examples.output: A usage billing outline covering event tracking, billing period aggregation, tiered pricing, invoice line items, and audit checks.

best_practices: Test every billing workflow with sandbox payments before using live customer payment methods.
Keep an audit trail for invoices, payment attempts, plan changes, credits, and refunds.
Review tax, VAT, and GST requirements with qualified experts before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode billing cycles when customers need flexible renewal dates.
Do not cancel subscriptions after a single failed payment without retries or notice.
Do not treat sample tax rates as production compliance rules.

faq.question: Can this skill charge real customers?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples. Your application and payment provider control any real charges.

faq.question: Does this skill support Stripe or other processors?
faq.answer: It includes payment processor patterns, but you must adapt them to your provider and security requirements.

faq.question: Can it help with invoices?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers invoice states, line items, totals, tax fields, delivery, and payment status handling.

faq.question: Can it calculate taxes for production?
faq.answer: No. It explains tax calculation patterns, but production tax logic needs verified rates and compliance review.

faq.question: Is it useful for usage-based billing?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains usage tracking, period aggregation, tiered pricing, and adding usage charges to invoices.
